ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent case of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and explore the larger issue of fraud prevention in the state's Medicaid system.
questions: How did the suspect manage to steal $11 million from Minnesota Medicaid?
What measures are in place to prevent similar cases of fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: As an AI detective, I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the need for increased oversight in the Medicaid system.
